hypotheses: S: A and B are true surfaces of the same persistent state; target surface A union B.
M: B is the true current moved state; target surface B; A-only surface is obsolete.
measure: One fixed physical surface measure μ, applied equally to every action; do not count repeated vertices or rays as independent loss. Here a=μ(A minus B), b=μ(B minus A).
loss: L(G,H)=μ(G minus true_surface(H))+μ(true_surface(H) minus G), with same physical-unit costs. This is one possible explicit common geometry loss, not a GT-fitted objective.
derivation: For posterior p=P(M|Y), R(U)=p a, R(D)=p a+b, R(N)=(1-p)a.
D is dominated by U whenever b>0, regardless of q or geometric BF. Under these two hypotheses, B's actually observed valid surface is omitted by D in either case.
Equal-unit U vs N decision at p=1/2 follows a common loss, but the current P08 alternate action is D, not N. Applying that two-action threshold to U vs D is unjustified.
Unequal omission/ghost costs still give R(D)-R(U)=positive B-omission cost when B is valid under both hypotheses; changing the cost ratio alone does not remove dominance.
third_hypothesis_obligation: If D is to minimize risk, add an explicit hypothesis that B is an invalid/false association, or an explicit source-valid action constraint/cost. Under a false-B state T and otherwise unchanged geometry with valid A, U adds cost c while D does not; R(D)-R(U)=(1-P(T|Y))b-P(T|Y)c. D requires independently derived false-B posterior, not movement prior q. Poor reconstruction coverage by itself does not establish false physical identity.
geometry_note: Raw vertex counts above identify omitted observed patches, not unbiased area estimators. They are not plugged in as algorithm costs or tuned thresholds.
consequence: P08 retained local symmetric association story does not yet justify actual union/old-only actions. The mathematical completion gate stays false. Review P08 after current frozen P07 trial finishes; no source mutation during mapper/scoring.
